pages.text: A placed head is a $(l)trophy$() until someone hires it: by paying its wage by hand (wheat for a cow, two rotten flesh for a zombie) or by giving it $(l:headinajar:staffing/desk)lunch$(/l). Whoever does is its employer.
Staff wear a badge in the employer's team colour, company teal without one.$(br2)At each dawn a head on the payroll takes one wage from a chest, barrel or other container touching it.
A head left unloaded for a week takes one wage, not seven. A trophy never touches the chest beside it.$(br2)Paying by hand twice in a day does nothing: it was paid today.

Starts at 50: +10 a wage paid, -15 a dawn unpaid.$(br)$(l)Engaged$(), 75-100: chin up$(br)$(l)Content$(), 40-74$(br)$(l)Disengaged$(), 15-39: sags, looks away$(br)$(l)Grievance$(): under 15 two dawns running. Faces the wall and stops work; a cake or back to 40 ends it.
pages.title: Form 40-M: Morale

pages.text: Heads at stations show Content.$(br)An Employee Mount's villager, by its pay: today and yesterday, Engaged; today, Content; unpaid 1-2 days, Disengaged; 3 or more, Grievance.
pages.title: Form 40-M (2)

pages.text: A villager head is never paid by hand: an emerald in hand opens its trades, as it always has. Lunch hires it, and slimes, ghasts, tadpoles and the others that draw no wage.
At dawn, on lunch: fed, +5 (up to 60); hungry, -5 (down to 30).$(br)Colleague of its department within 8: +2. Rival within 4: -5. A dislike: -5.$(br)Any time: cake, +40, once a day; sampled, -10.
pages.title: Form 40-M (3)

pages.text: $(l)Dislikes$(): panda, thunder; bee, enderman, rain; polar bear, heat; zombie, drowned, zombie villager, skeleton, phantom, open sky; blaze, rain, water; strider, outside the Nether; snow golem, warmth, rain; hoglin, warped fungus.

$(l)Rivals$(): villager and zombie villager, pillager or vindicator; skeleton and wolf; piglin and wither skeleton; creeper and cat or ocelot; spider and armadillo.$(br2)$(o)A pizza party is not a pay rise.$()
